title: Yellow Molten Polish Pork Dumplings
description: Salty, molten, lazy-sunday polish dish featuring unflavored gelatin and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, unflavored gelatin, yellow onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and mix well until just combined.
Gradually add the all-purpose flour to the pork mixture, stirring with a wooden spoon until a dough forms.
Add the egg and water to the dough, and mix until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, and place a tablespoon of vegetable oil in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the oil to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and add the dumplings to the skillet, seam-side down.
Cook the dumplings for 5 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Flambe the dumplings with a small amount of oil, and serve hot.
